Semantics of address space switching and control image sync and copy and enlightened mapping and event checks and triple fault and dirty logging helpers.

findings.text: A vendor nested operations table centralizes nested duties such as leaving nesting and translating nested addresses and classifying exception exits and polling nested events and handling triple faults and saving and restoring nested state with paging support and dirty logging, plus extra enlightened hooks only when Hyper-V support is compiled.

The fragment labelled for one handler implements virtual function dispatch that requires active inner guest execution, and outside that mode it raises an undefined opcode fault and reports the instruction handled without exiting.

Virtual function selectors are bounded above and must be advertised as present, with out of range or unadvertised values taking an undefined opcode fault that has priority over exiting, and enablement seen by the inner guest matches enablement in the outer control image.

On success only the single supported selector advances past the emulated instruction after its address space switching helper succeeds, while disabled selectors and unsupported selectors and helper failure all reflect the original exit to the outer guest preserving reason and auxiliary details rather than synthesizing a fresh exit.

The nested state query supports a size probe when no target is given and otherwise starts from cleared flags with a virtualization format tag and base length and invalid sentinels for region pointers and a cleared deadline, returning the required length without copying when the caller buffer is too small.

Saved state is populated only when the virtual CPU advertises the virtualization feature and has an active region either normally or through management mode, exporting region addresses and growing total length for a main control image and an optional shadow image and setting distinct indicators for enlightened backing and guest mode and pending run and pending trap and management states and deadline presence.

Exported control state uses different authoritative sources by mode, synchronizing from the hardware loaded image including a rare portion while inner execution is active, and while outer execution is active synchronizing a rare portion and preferring enlightened or shadow backing with a full copy that ignores cleanliness hints unless a flag requires the opposite direction.
Control state counts as present when either the current pointer differs from all ones or an enlightened pointer is considered set, where a pending mapping marker also satisfies the set test.

The nested state exchange area has a fixed header with flags and format tag and total length and region addresses using an invalid sentinel and a deadline with presence indication and management mode indicators, followed conditionally by a main control image and an optional shadow image whose presence enlarges the total.

Restoring nested state validates the format tag and rejects inconsistent absent region combinations and missing feature or invalid region address when a region is claimed and simultaneous management and normal guest indications and unknown management or deadline option bits and misplaced management state relative to management mode and management guest without management active and enlightened requests without both feature and enablement.

A restore leaves current nesting first and completes immediately when no region is supplied, otherwise records the region and enters operation and permits an empty region only without guest or enlightened or loaded control indications, then requires distinct valid region and control addresses or defers enlightened mapping through a request, restores management markers, copies and revision checks the control image, and for guest mode restores pending run as untrusted plus trap and optional shadow and deadline state before validating and entering non root mode and requesting event delivery when trap is pending, clearing pending run on guest mode errors.

Nested address translation requires active nested paging, clears the user fault indication for mode based execute control handling, reinstates it only when both the page table entry indicates user and the access represents a guest final translation, then delegates to the per CPU walk helper.
A preprocessor symbol guards the nested header against multiple inclusion.

Attempted entry into inner guest mode resolves to one of four abstract outcomes distinguishing clean entry from consistency failure reported as a failure code and consistency failure reported as an exit and internal host error.
Guest and host control register validation names alias one shared validator.
Diagnostic formatting prefixes messages with the module name.

Counter read indexing distinguishes general and fixed classes with general as zero and fixed at an architectural base, while the selector word splits into a high type field over bits sixteen through thirty one and a low index field over bits zero through fifteen.
A bit distinguishing full width counter accesses is defined as the numerical distance between two general counter register bases.

Fixed counter control updates keep both a guest visible copy and a hardware shadow copy, compare each counter field against the prior hardware value, and on any per counter change mark that counter in use and request reprogramming while leaving unchanged counters untouched.

Counter lookup from a read selector rejects non architectural performance versions, accepts only general and fixed types with the fixed class permitted even when no fixed hardware exists so absence surfaces as a missing counter, bounds checks the masked index against the class count, narrows the caller mask by class width, and hardens the final array access against speculation.
Alternate base general counter resolution is available only when firmware writes are enabled for the virtual CPU, otherwise it yields absence.
Branch record compatibility is denied for trust domain guests and otherwise follows whether the virtual CPU model remains consistent.

Branch record register acceptance requires the feature to be enabled and then covers two singleton selectors plus contiguous source and destination windows sized by the record count, with an additional info window only when its base is present.

Performance register acceptance grants global and fixed control only when global control exists, gates precise event and debug area and configuration selectors on respective capability or feature indications, and otherwise accepts any general or fixed or firmware wide or branch record match.
Register to counter resolution prefers fixed backing then event select backing then counter backing, yielding absence when none match.

Releasing the guest branch record event does nothing without a descriptor or without an active kernel event, otherwise it drops the kernel reference and clears the handle and decrements the performance event count.
Branch record register accesses mask local interrupts around the active state test and the hardware read or write, restoring interrupts on both the active path and the reclaimed path.

If guest branch record event creation fails or the event is no longer active, reads observe zero and writes are absorbed as success rather than exposing host values, and in use marking tracks only the active path.

Performance reads serve fixed control and precise event and debug area and configuration state directly, serve general and fixed counters through a read helper masked to class width, serve event selectors raw, delegate branch record selectors to a dedicated handler, and report unhandled for anything else.

Performance writes reject reserved bits and noncanonical addresses, reprogram only on value change for fixed control and precise event enablement and event selectors with a special reservation adjustment for one counter under a checkpointed transaction allowance, distinguish full width masked writes from sign extended narrow writes for general counters, write fixed counters directly, delegate branch record selectors, and report unhandled for unknown selectors.

Unexpected host states such as missing guest mode during inner handling and missing nested paging during translation and zero performance version during counter lookup are treated as one time warnings returning safe fallbacks rather than proceeding.

User copies for nested state save and restore treat access failures as faults, and undersized restore images and mismatched revision and failed consistency checks abort guest mode entry with pending run cleared.
